constitutional_basis: Article XXX (strongest way system could be wrong), Article XXXII (strongest alternative), Article XV (disclose inconvenient results)

experimental_design.purpose: Isolate redundancy from conductance retention. Match baseline hydraulic conductance, then apply matched obstruction.
experimental_design.distributed_baseline: 10 channels at 0.1x flow each, normal R (Rp=121, Rd=1212)
experimental_design.single_baseline_matched: 1 channel at 1.0x flow, R/10 (Rp=12.1, Rd=121.2) — designed to match distributed baseline conductance
experimental_design.distributed_50pct: 5/10 channels at 0.2x flow each, normal R
experimental_design.single_50pct_matched: 1 channel at 1.0x flow, R/5 (Rp=24.2, Rd=242.4) — half conductance lost from matched baseline

honest_analysis.baseline_match_quality: IMPERFECT — distributed baseline 9.87 mmHg vs single matched baseline 17.85 mmHg. The single channel at R/10 has 1.81x higher pressure than distributed at baseline. The analytical Poiseuille prediction was that they should be equal. The 3D solver shows they are NOT equal.
honest_analysis.why_baseline_mismatch: The 3D Navier-Stokes solver captures physics beyond 1D Poiseuille: entrance effects (flow development at inlet), wall shear stress distribution, non-uniform velocity profiles. At 1.0x flow (single), these effects are larger than at 0.1x flow (distributed per channel). The single channel at high flow has higher effective resistance than the analytical R/10.
honest_analysis.obstruction_comparison: Distributed 50%: 19.75 mmHg. Single 50%: 29.28 mmHg. Distributed is 33% lower. BUT baseline was not matched, so this is confounded.

proportional_degradation.finding: The SINGLE channel degraded LESS proportionally than the distributed architecture. This is the OPPOSITE of what P-19's thesis predicts.

what_this_means.1D_prediction: At matched baseline conductance and matched obstruction, distributed and single should produce identical pressure (Poiseuille: P = Q/G regardless of channel count).
what_this_means.3D_result: The 3D solver shows: (1) baseline conductance is NOT perfectly matched by the analytical R/10 scaling, (2) under obstruction, the single channel actually degrades LESS proportionally than distributed. The distributed architecture's advantage may be SMALLER than the 1D model predicts, or may not exist at all when baseline is properly matched.
what_this_means.honest_conclusion: P-19's redundancy advantage is NOT confirmed under conductance-matched conditions. The 3D solver reveals physics that the 1D model misses: at higher per-channel flow (single), entrance effects and wall shear create additional resistance that partially offsets the obstruction penalty. This means the single channel is MORE resilient than 1D predicts.

corrected_classification.MATCHED_BASELINE_HYDRAULIC_PERFORMANCE: PARTIAL — analytical match attempted but 3D solver shows 1.81x baseline mismatch
corrected_classification.REDUNDANCY_MECHANISM: NOT_CONFIRMED — 3D result shows single channel degrades less proportionally. The redundancy advantage may not survive conductance matching.
corrected_classification.P-19_state: MODEL_DISAGREEMENT — 1D and 3D disagree on the redundancy advantage. P-19 cannot be TTR until this is resolved.

article_XXX_compliance: The strongest way the system could appear correct while being wrong: the 1D model predicts distributed advantage, but the 3D solver (with entrance effects, wall shear, non-uniform velocity) shows the single channel is more resilient than 1D predicts. The distributed advantage may be an artifact of the 1D model's inability to capture 3D flow effects at high per-channel velocity.
what_R322_proved: The machine found that its own P-19 claim is weaker than expected when tested under proper controls. This is the machine working correctly — it found the confound before a buyer would have.
next_steps: Attempt better conductance matching: adjust single-channel R iteratively until 3D baseline matches distributed baseline within 5%
If baseline matched and distributed STILL wins: P-19 mechanism confirmed
If baseline matched and single wins or ties: P-19 redundancy advantage does not exist — downgrade to CEMETERY or revise thesis
